external_sources.used_for: Confirm the official Tauri local persisted-state model in app data.
Confirm store paths are saved under app_data_dir.
Confirm app data directory is the correct local desktop runtime data location.
Evaluate SQLite WAL as a future option and note why this slice avoids a database migration.

decision_summary: Selected a versioned JSON manifest under the Tauri app-data runtime index directory. Existing per-record task/log/audit files remain authoritative raw records, while the manifest becomes the stable user-visible overview storage format.
